translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Jesucristuta jusalicasiyta Satanás munashgan
Jordán mayucho Jesús bautizacushganpitanami Santu Espíritu payta pushargan sunyag jircaman.
Saychömi chuscu chunca (40) junagnintin Satanás payta camargan jusalicasinanpä. Say junagcuna ayunar manami imatapis micorgansu. Saymi wanunayparä Jesusta micanay saricuycorgan.
Sayno micanaycaptinmi Satanás yuripaycur nergan: “Diospa surin caycarga micunayquipä cay rumita tantaman ticrarasiy, ari.”
Sayno niptin Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diospa palabrancho caynömi nican:
Saypitanami altunnin puntapita Satanás elagpita ricasergan may-say nacioncunata.

Nircurmi nergan: “Gongurpaycur nogata adoramaptiquega cay ricashgayqui nacioncunata y saycho cag riquëzacunatami goycushayqui. Lapan ricashgayquicunataga noga chasquishcä munashgä cagta pitapis goycunäpämi.”
Saymi Jesús nergan: “[¡Witicuy, Satanás!] Tayta Diospa palabranchöga caynömi nican:
Saypitanami elagpita Jesusta Satanás ricacascasergan Jerusalén templo janancho. Saychönami payta nergan: “Diospa surin carga caypita pampaman saltarpuy.
Diospa palabranchöga caynömi guelgaraycan:

content.text: ‘Angilnincunatami Tayta Diosninsi cachamonga maycho captiquipis cuidashunayquipä.
Paycunami sariyäshunqui pampaman jegaptiqui ni chaquilayquitapis rumicunaman mana tacacunayquipä.’ ”

content: Niptinmi Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diospa palabranchöga caynömi nican:

content.text: ‘Tayta Diosta ama obligaysu quiquiqui munashgayquita rurasinayquipä.’ ”

content: Sauraga yarpashganta rurasiyta mana camäpacurcurnami payta cachaycur Satanás aywacorgan yapay cutimunanyag.
Galileacho Jesucristo ali wilacuyta wilacur galaycushgan
Saypitami Santu Espiritupa munayninwanna Jesús cutergan Galilea provinciaman. Intëru say marcacunachömi paypita runacuna parlayargan.
Say marcacunacho cag sinagogacunacho Jesús yachasiptinmi lapan runacuna: “Ali yachasicogmi payga” niyargan.
Nazaret marcacho Jesucristo wilacushgan

Saypitanami Jesús aywargan naupata tashgan Nazaret marcaman. Saymi imaypis aywashganno sábado jamay junagcho aywargan sinagogaman. Saychönami runacunapa puntanman aywargan Tayta Diosninsipa palabranta liyimunanpä.
Saycho liyimunanpämi macyargan profëta Isaías guelgashganta. Saymi liyimorgan:

content.text: “Santu Espiritutami Tayta Dios nogaman cachamush yanapämänanpä.
Paymi acrarcamar yanapaycäman muchog runacunaman ali wilacuyta apanäpä.
Saynöpis cachamash carcilcho cagcuna librina cayänanpä cashganta wilanäpä,
y Tayta Diosninsita cäsucur ali cawayänanpä cag tiempo chämushgantana wilacunäpäpis.”

content: Sayno liyircurnami Isaías guelgashganta Jesús cutiycasergan sinagogacho yanapag runata. Cutiycasir jamacuycuptinmi saycho caycag runacuna payta ricaraycäyargan.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Say liyimushgäta unay guelgargan noga ruranäpä cagcunapitami. Say guelgaraycashganno cumpliycashgäta gamcuna ricaycäyanquinami.”
Sayno niptinmi runacuna Jesuspa contran parlayargan: “¿Imatatä pay musyan sayno parlananpä? ¿Manacu cayga Josëpa surin?”

Saymi Jesús nergan: “Gamcuna capascher yarpaycäyanqui Capernaumcho milagruta rurashgäno cay marcansichöpis milagruta ruranäpä cashganta. Sayno yarpäyashgayquega runacuna cayno niyashgannölami caycan: ‘Jampicog carga quiquiquirä jampicuy.’ ”
Nircurmi Jesús nergan: “Tayta Diosninsipa profëtancuna quiquinpa marcancho mana chasquish cashgannömi gamcunapis chasquiycäyämanquisu.

Yarpäyay Tayta Diosninsipa wilacognin Elías cawanan wisan imano päsashgantapis. Quimsa wata sogta quilantin mana tamyaptin lapan marcacunachöshi muchuy cargan. Say wisan Israel nacioncho asca viüdacuna caycaptinpis Tayta Diosninsi manashi cachargansu Eliasta maygan viüdata yanapänanpäpis. Saypa trucanga cachargan Sidoncho cag Sarepta nishgan marcacho tag viüdalata yanapänanpäshi.

Saynöpis Tayta Diosninsipa wilacognin Eliseo cawanan wisan Israel nacioncho ascagshi cayargan leprawan gueshyaycagcuna. Say gueshyawan ascag gueshyaycäyaptinpis Eliseo manashi aliyäsergansu maygantapis. Siria nacionpita cag Naamantashi isanga aliyäsergan.”
Sauraga Jesús sayno nishganta wiyaycur saycho cagcuna tantyacuyargan paycunapä milagruta rurananpa trucanga juclä marcacunalacho rurananpä cashgantami. Saymi fiyupa rabianäyargan.
Gaga janancho paycunapa marcan captinmi Jesusta apayargan gaga quilunman saypita tangariyänanpä.
Saypita tangayänanpä apaycäyaptinmi paycunapa chaupinpita yargurir Jesús aywacorgan.
Supay löcuyäsishgan runata Jesucristo cachacäsishgan
Saypitami Galilea provinciacho cag Capernaum marcaman Jesús aywargan. Saychömi cada sábado jamay junag runacunata yachasergan.
Jesusga manami waquin yachasegcunanösu yachasergan, sinöga paycunapita más alimi yachasergan. Sayno yachasiptinmi runacuna fiyupa cushicuyargan.
Say sinagogachömi caycargan supay löcuyäsishgan runa. Paymi gaparargan:
“¡Nazaret marcapita cag Jesús! ¿Imatatä munanqui nogacunawan? ¿Nogacunata gargayämänayquipäcu shamushcanqui? ¡Noga musyämi Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashgayquita!”
Sayno niptinmi Jesús olgutupargan supayta: “¡Upälala cay runapita jucla yarguy!” nir. Sayno niptinmi lapan runacunapa naupancho say runata sagtariycur supay aywacorgan.
Sayta ricaycurmi lapan runacuna cushicuyashpan jucninpis jucninpis cayno parlayargan: “¡Imajinanparä munayyog caycan supaycuna payta cäsucuyänanpäga!”
Supayta gargushganta musyarmi lapan marcacunacho runacuna parlayargan Jesús munayyog cashganta.
Asca gueshyagcunata Jesucristo aliyäsishgan
Sauraga sinagogapitanami Jesús aywargan Simonpa wayinman. Chänanpämi Simonpa suedran fiebriwan ansa jitaraycargan. Saymi saycho caycag runacuna Jesusta ruwacuyargan payta aliyäsinanpä.
Say fiebrita Jesús olgutupaptinmi Simonpa suedran jinan höra aliyasquergan. Aliyarcurnami micuyta paycunata garargan.
Saypita inti jegaycaptinnami Jesusman apayargan tucuy-nirag gueshyawan gueshyaycagcunata. Say gueshyagcuna yatayculaptinmi aliyäyargan.

Saynömi waquin gueshyagcunapitapis supaycuna yarguyargan cayno gaparäyashpan: “¡Gamga Diospa surinmi canqui!” nir. Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta wilacuyaptinmi supaycunata Jesús olgutupargan imatapis mana parlacuyänanpä.
Jesucristo wilacur purishgan
Pasa wararcuptinnami marcapita Jesús aywargan sunyagninman. Saymi runacuna ashishpan pay caycashgan cagman chäyargan. Saycho tariycur manacuyargan paycuna cagpita mana aywacunanpä.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Waquin marcacunachöpis Tayta Diosninsipa wilacuyninta wilacunämi caycan. Saypämi Tayta Diosninsi cachamash.”
Saymi sinagogacunacho may-saychöpis Jesús wilacorgan Tayta Diosninsipa wilacuyninta.
